parameters.content:
## get_seo_article
Conversation-bound read of a queued, failed, or saved review draft. Makes no paid or model call.

parameters.jsCode: const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i,sessionId=String($json.sessionId??'').trim(),requestId=String($json.requestId??'').trim(),jobId=String($json.jobId??'').trim();let domain=String($json.domain??'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').split('/')[0].replace(/^www\./,'').replace(/\.$/,'');let error=null;if(!uuid.test(sessionId)||!uuid.test(requestId))error={code:'INVALID_REQUEST',message:'The article lookup needs a valid conversation.'};else if(jobId&&!/^article-[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(jobId))error={code:'INVALID_JOB_ID',message:'Use the exact article job from this conversation.'};else if(!jobId&&!domain)error={code:'ARTICLE_ID_REQUIRED',message:'Tell me which business domain article to check.'};else if(domain&&(domain.includes('@')||domain.includes(':')||domain.split('.').length<2))error={code:'INVALID_DOMAIN',message:'Use a complete saved business domain.'};return{json:{valid:!error,sessionId,requestId,jobId,domain,...(error?{response:{ok:false,error}}:{})}};

const input=$('Validate Article Lookup').first().json,statusCode=Number($json.statusCode??0),body=$json.body??$json.data??{},job=body.job,article=body.article,previous=body.previousArticle;if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||!job)return{json:{...input,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND',message:'I could not find that article in this conversation.'}}}};if(['queued','running'].includes(job.status))return{json:{...input,response:{ok:true,ready:false,status:job.status,stage:job.stage,domain:job.domain,primaryKeyword:job.primaryKeyword,message:job.status==='queued'?'The article is queued. Ask me to check it again shortly.':'The article is still being prepared. Ask me to check it again shortly.'}}};if(job.status==='failed'||job.status==='interrupted')return{json:{...input,response:{ok:false,ready:false,status:job.status,previousDraftAvailable:!!previous?.downloadUrl,previousDownloadUrl:previous?.downloadUrl??'',error:{code:job.errorCode??'ARTICLE_FAILED',message:(job.errorMessage??'The article did not finish, and no new draft was saved.')+(previous?.downloadUrl?' The earlier successful draft is still available.':'')}}}};if(!article?.downloadUrl)return{json:{...input,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_NOT_SAVED',message:'The job finished without a readable saved draft.'}}}};const meta=article.metadata??{};return{json:{...input,response:{ok:true,ready:true,status:job.status,domain:job.domain,primaryKeyword:job.primaryKeyword,title:meta.seoTitle??'',summary:meta.metaDescription??'',reviewStatus:article.reviewStatus,warnings:Array.isArray(article.warnings)?article.warnings.slice(0,8):[],qualityScore:article.qualityReport?.score,downloadUrl:article.downloadUrl,message:'The review draft is ready. Download the Markdown file to read or edit it.'}}};

const i=$('Validate Article Lookup').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND',message:'The article is unavailable.'}};return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:i.sessionId,requestId:i.requestId,toolName:'get_seo_article',proposedInput:JSON.stringify({jobId:i.jobId,domain:i.domain}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The lookup could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
